text:
alyssa: Quick proposal — for next week's product launch + benchmark webinar, I want a 3-email nurture: launch announcement, webinar reminder, and a 48hr post-webinar follow-up with benchmark highlights. keep it lightweight. :rocket:
mike: sounds good. what are our audience buckets?
sophie: primary = trial users who hit embeddings endpoints in last 14 days. secondary = newsletter-only list (eng product folks). tertiary = partners / pilots.
alyssa: + add a suppression for anyone who attended last month's benchmark webinar (avoid repeat invites).
jordan: timeline? i can draft the announcement copy today if needed.
alyssa: timeline: announce Tue 09:00PT, webinar Thu 10:00PT, reminder Thu 1hr before, post-webinar Fri 09:00PT. need final subject lines by Mon EOD for QA.
neha: A/B test idea: Subject A — "See how X reduced inference cost by 3x" vs Subject B — "Benchmark: cheaper, faster inference for production". both to trial audience only.
mike: good. for newsletter-only list we should soft-sell: "what to expect in the benchmark" + CTA to register. avoid deep pricing language.
sophie: segment query for trial users: `event:embedding_call AND created_at:>now-14d AND plan:trial AND not:event:benchmark_attended` — can someone validate this against CDP?
jordan: i will validate with analytics. tagging @neha for the suppression check.
neha: confirmed, CDP filter works but need to add dedupe across lists (email hashing) so folks in multiple lists only see the earliest send.
alyssa: send cadence note — stagger sends by 5 minutes to spread load. also enable unsubscribe-suppress for any bounced addresses.
marcom-bot: Campaign draft "benchmark-launch-1718" created: https://app.redwood/marketing/campaigns/bench-launch-1718
mike: layout: header image, short 3 bullets (what we measured, why it matters, what you can expect), CTA button to register. Also include a 60s video embed for social proof.
sophie: tracking UTM: `utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=bench_launch_1718&utm_medium=email` — add to all links.
jordan: can we add a tiny form to capture team size on registration? helps qualify.
neha: yep — will add `?team_size=` param to registration URL and capture via GTM.
alyssa: analytics: need click/open dashboards and cohort conversions (register -> attend -> demo request). assign owners?
mike: i'll own creative and html. jordan owns copy + subject lines. neha owns segmentation + analytics. sophie will QA and schedule.
sophie: timeline check: i'll run test sends Tue AM to the 3-person internal list. please add any copy comments before Mon 11:00PT.
ajordan: noted, will post first draft in this thread by Monday 09:00PT.
alyssa: perfect. small checklist for Monday: 1) finalize subject A/B 2) confirm segment queries + dedupe 3) creative files uploaded 4) tracking params in links 5) test send & QA.
mike: adding quick note — for post-webinar follow-up swap CTA to "get the benchmark report" and include a TL;DR bullet list.
neha: one more: suppress anyone who converted to paid in the last 7 days from the nurture (they get a different upsell flow).
sophie: got it. I'll update the campaign settings.
alyssa: thanks team! will loop in sales ops for demo routing after webinar. :raised_hands: 
mike: :thumbsup:
marcom-bot: Reminder scheduled: send checklist ping 24 hours before announce (Mon 09:00PT).
